info.name: Honeycomb Auth Service Maps API
info.description: The API allows programmatic management of many resources within Honeycomb. Please report any discrepancies with actual API behavior in Pollinators Slack or to Honeycomb Support. Contact Support: Email: support@honeycomb.io

variable.description: (Required) The unique identifier (ID) of a Map Dependencies Request.

request.description: Get the dependencies for a previously created Map Dependencies Request. Note: This endpoint returns a single page of results and uses pagination. Even if you specified a large limit in the initial POST request, you will receive up to the page size limit per request and must use the pagination links to retrieve additional results.
